models.name: Document
models.documentation: A document submitted by a client system, before embedding.

all_fields.name: externalId
all_fields.documentation: Caller-supplied natural key. Stable across re-ingestion of the same document.

all_fields.name: idempotencyKey
all_fields.documentation: Deduplication key for exactly-once consumption. Unique across the whole stream.

all_fields.name: source
all_fields.documentation: Originating system, e.g. "support-tickets" or "product-catalog".

all_fields.name: occurredAt
all_fields.documentation: Event time as reported by the producer, not ingestion time.

all_fields.name: contentHash
all_fields.documentation: SHA-256 of `text`, hex encoded. Used for corpus dedup and eval reproducibility.

all_fields.name: objectKey
all_fields.documentation: MinIO object key holding the raw ingested payload. Null until the upload lands.

models.name: Embedding
models.documentation: The 384-dimensional embedding of a document, produced by a specific model version.

all_fields.name: modelVersionId
all_fields.documentation:
Null only for embeddings produced by the un-tuned base model before any
version was registered.

all_fields.name: dimension
all_fields.documentation: Denormalised for cheap validation; must equal 384 for the MiniLM family.

models.name: DriftWindow
models.documentation: An aggregated drift measurement over one time window.

all_fields.name: klDivergence
all_fields.documentation: Divergence measures against `baseline`. Null until enough samples accumulate.

all_fields.name: driftScore
all_fields.documentation: Normalised composite score in [0, 1].

all_fields.name: threshold
all_fields.documentation: Threshold in force when this window was scored, captured for auditability.

all_fields.name: baselineId
all_fields.documentation: The window this one was compared against. Null for baseline windows themselves.

models.name: ModelVersion
models.documentation: An entry in the model registry.

all_fields.name: version
all_fields.documentation: Human-facing identifier, e.g. "2026.07.26-1". Immutable once created.

all_fields.name: baseModel
all_fields.documentation: Hugging Face id of the model this version was adapted from.

all_fields.name: artifactUri
all_fields.documentation: MinIO URI of the exported ONNX artifact.

all_fields.name: artifactSha256
all_fields.documentation: SHA-256 of the artifact, hex encoded. Verified on load before serving.

all_fields.name: loraRank
all_fields.documentation: LoRA rank used for this adapter. Null for the base model.

all_fields.name: metrics
all_fields.documentation: Eval results for this version, e.g. { "mrr": 0.71, "recall_at_5": 0.83 }.

all_fields.name: baselineMetrics
all_fields.documentation: The same metric shape for the version this one was gated against.

all_fields.name: improvementPct
all_fields.documentation: Relative MRR improvement over baseline, as a fraction. Gate requires > 0.10.

all_fields.name: driftWindowId
all_fields.documentation: The drift window that triggered this job. Null for MANUAL and SCHEDULED runs.

all_fields.name: modelVersionId
all_fields.documentation: The version this job produced. Null until training succeeds.

all_fields.name: hyperparameters
all_fields.documentation: Full hyperparameter set, captured so a run can be reproduced exactly.

all_fields.name: sampleCount
all_fields.documentation: Number of documents sampled into the training set.

all_fields.name: error
all_fields.documentation: Failure message from the final attempt. Null unless status is FAILED.

all_fields.name: lossHistory
all_fields.documentation: Per-step loss, streamed to the dashboard: [{ "step": 1, "loss": 0.42 }, ...].
